method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of an individual affected by an act or decision of a Queensland public entity, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; dates in one module, the rules in another, the individual's exported questions in a third (each calls a rule in the core), worked cases in a fourth; three regulative rules (s 52 notice, s 78(5) direction to give information, s 100(2) anonymity direction) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Human Rights Act 2019 (Qld), Act No. 5 of 2019, the version in force from 2023-09-20 (current on 2026-11-06), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2019-005.txt (text sha256 5f7bf859715bd4eef369a2009b38c3f82d9408bc281edcaa213cdced8ffdc09c), converted from the Queensland Legislation HTML whole view; not the authorised version

seat: the individual: a person affected by an act or decision (or failure to act) of a Queensland public entity -- a prisoner (including in a privately run prison), a person held by police, a child in State care or youth detention, a public hospital patient, a tenant of a funded housing provider, a person hurt by a council or a State agency -- who may complain to the Queensland Human Rights Commissioner and may have a claim apart from the Act (hrq-seat.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run hrq-dates.l4 ; l4 run hrq-core.l4 ; l4 run hrq-seat.l4 ; l4 run hrq-cases.l4
checks.result: 256 assertions written, 256 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: s 8; s 9 (every head, inclusion and exclusion) with s 10(3); s 11; s 7 and Part 2 (every right named; ss 16, 17, 25, 26(2), 29, 30, 31, 33, 37 limb by limb); s 13 (as a finding); ss 45(1), (2), 46; s 48; s 49; s 52 (regulative); s 54(b); s 58; s 59; s 60(3) via s 9(3); ss 63-65, 66(2)(b), 67, 69-73, 75, 76, 78 (regulative), 82-84, 86-90, 99, 100 (regulative), 102; s 108(2). Out: the other Part 2 rights limb by limb, including s 26(1), (3) (named, reachable through s 58); Part 3 Division 1, ss 43, 44, 47, 50, 51, 53, 55-57, 60(1), (2) (Parliament, courts, Minister, commission); Part 4 Division 1, ss 66(1), (2)(a), 68, 74, 77, 79, 80, 85, Division 3 and Part 5 reporting (ss 91-98), ss 101, 103-105 (machinery); s 81 (the commissioner's power to direct participation; no duty stated in the Act itself); ss 1-6, 12, 14, 106, 107, 108(1), (3) (no rule a person applies); the commencement proclamation, regulations and approved forms (not deposited; asked). Reasons in NOTES.md.
